ctaLabel: Buy tickets on the Students' Union site
steps: If you aren't logged in to the Students' Union website, select "Student" at the bottom of the page and log in with your university account.
Once logged in, click "ADD TO BASKET" next to the Hackers Ticket item, then click "Proceed to basket".
Then click "Proceed to Payment". No payment details are required apart from a billing address.
emailNote: Make sure you have access to the email since that is where your ticket will be sent. It is also where we will send the Hack-A-Bot 2026 Participant Form where we will take in your Student ID and any dietary requirements you have.
